g.title: note
g.text: Money (integer millimes) is the type of every amount.
build_bill() turns a Reservation, its charges, discounts, applicable
taxes and payments into a Bill; an Invoice freezes its lines.
Ids (guest_id, room_id...) are the associations drawn as lines.
